Pregas musculofibrosas cobertas externam: Musculofibrous folds covered externally by skin and internally by mucosa.
Prega mucosa que liga o lábio à gengiva: Mucosal fold that connects the lip to the adjacent gingiva.
Onde se abrem o ducto da glândula subman: Where the submandibular gland duct opens on each side.
A Cavidade Oral consiste em Vestíbulo da: The Oral Cavity consists of the Vestibule of the Mouth and the Oral Cavity Proper. The vestibule is a slit between the lips and cheeks externally, and the gingiva and teeth internally. The oral cavity proper, in turn, is the space internal to the dental arches and contains the tongue.
É uma fina camada óssea que separa a cav: It is a thin bony layer that separates the oral cavity from the nasal cavity, formed anteriorly by the palatine process of the maxilla and posteriorly by the horizontal plate of the palatine bone.
Compõe o limite entre a cavidade própria: Forms the boundary between the oral cavity proper and the oral part of the pharynx.
É limitada anteriomente pelo arco palato: It is bounded anteriorly by the palatoglossal arch and posteriorly by the palatopharyngeal arch. It houses the palatine tonsil.
Prega fibromuscular móvel suspensa da ma: Movable fibromuscular fold suspended from the posterior margin of the hard palate, constituting the posterior third of the palate.
Sulco em forma de V com ápice apontado p: V-shaped sulcus with the apex pointed posteriorly towards the foramen cecum, divides the dorsum of the tongue into the body (anterior 2/3) and root (posterior 1/3).
Comunicação entre a cavidade própria da: Communication between the oral cavity proper and the oral part of the pharynx. It is bounded superiorly by the soft palate, inferiorly by the dorsum of the tongue, and laterally by the palatoglossal arches.
Median projection of the soft palate.
Resquício não funcional da parte proxima: Non-functional remnant of the proximal part of the embryonic thyroglossal duct from which the thyroid gland developed.
Corresponde ao terço posterior da língua: Corresponds to the posterior third of the tongue (fixed part), where the lingual tonsils are located.
Localizam-se anteriormente ao sulco term: They are located anterior to the terminal sulcus and number approximately 7.
Corresponde aos 2/3 anteriores da língua: Corresponds to the anterior 2/3 of the tongue (movable part).
Prega lateral que liga a epiglote à líng: Lateral fold that connects the epiglottis to the tongue.
Depressão entre as pregas glossoepiglóti: Depression between the median and lateral glossoepiglottic folds.
Prega mediana que liga a epiglote à líng: Median fold that connects the epiglottis to the tongue.
Possuem superfície levemente arredondada: They have a slightly rounded surface, adapted for crushing and grinding food. They are bicuspid.
Possui forma cônica, adapatada para pren: It has a conical shape, adapted for grasping and tearing food.
Possuem margens cortantes e finas, adapt: They have thin, sharp edges, adapted for cutting food.
Possuem superfície ampla e plana, adapta: They have a wide, flat surface, adapted for crushing and grinding food. They have three or more joys.
O dente é subdividido em coroa, colo e r: The tooth is subdivided into crown, neck, and root. The crown is the portion of the tooth that projects from the gingiva. The neck is interposed between the crown and root. The root, in turn, is the portion fixed in the dental alveolus.
Órgão muscular oco entre o esôfago e o i: Hollow muscular organ between the esophagus and the small intestine, specialized in storing ingested food.
Tubo muscular com a função de transporta: Muscular tube with the function of transporting food from the pharynx to the stomach through muscular movements (peristalsis). It is divided into cervical, thoracic, and abdominal portions, with the diaphragm being the boundary between the latter two.
Parte adjacente à desembocadura do esôfa: Part adjacent to the opening of the esophagus, where the cardial orifice (superior opening of the stomach) is located.
Parte superior dilatada, localizada acim: Dilated upper part, located above the level of the esophageal opening.
Situa-se entre o fundo e a parte pilóric: It is located between the fundus and the pyloric part. Corresponds to the largest part of the stomach.
Constitutes the concave margin of the stomach.
Região de saída do estômago. Sua parte l: Outlet region of the stomach. Its wide part (pyloric antrum) is continuous with the narrow part (pyloric canal).
Constitutes the convex margin of the stomach.
É um espessamento da camada circular de: It is a thickening of the circular smooth muscle layer that controls the emptying of the stomach, regulating the passage of chyme through the pyloric orifice to the duodenum.
A mucosa do estômago, quando contraída,: The stomach mucosa, when contracted, forms gastric folds, which disappear when the organ distends.
In situ - Estruturas da Cavidade Abdomin: In situ - Structures of the Abdominal Cavity
Prega peritoneal que pende como um avent: Peritoneal fold that hangs like an apron from the greater curvature of the stomach and the proximal part of the duodenum, covering the structures of the abdominal cavity anteriorly.
Lâmina dupla de peritônio que possibilit: Double layer of peritoneum that allows neurovascular communication between the organ and the posterior abdominal wall.
Parte Superior do Duodeno: Superior (1st) Part of Duodenum - Duodenal Bulb ou Ampulla
É a segunda porção do intestino delgado,: It is the second portion of the small intestine, interposed between the duodenum and ileum. The ileum ends at the ileocecal junction, which corresponds to the beginning of the large intestine.
O duodeno é primeira porção do intestino: The duodenum is the first portion of the small intestine and is subdivided into superior, descending, horizontal, and ascending parts.
Pequena projeção mamilar na parede poste: Small mammillary projection on the posteromedial wall, where the main pancreatic duct and bile duct open (after joining to form the hepatopancreatic ampulla). The minor duodenal papilla (inconstant) is the drainage opening for the accessory pancreatic duct.
Pregas circulares são dobras de mucosa q: Circular folds are mucosal folds that project into the lumen of the small intestine.
As pregas circulares do jejuno são grand: The circular folds of the jejunum are large, tall, and close to each other.
As pregas circulares da porção proximal: The circular folds of the proximal portion of the ileum are low and become increasingly sparse.
As pregas circulares da porção distal do: The circular folds of the distal portion of the ileum are practically absent.
Condensação da musculatura longitudinal: Condensação da musculatura longitudinal que percorre o intestino grosso em quase toda a sua extensão. São em número de três: livre, omental e mesocólica.
Dilatações limitadas por sulcos transver: Dilations limited by transverse sulci. The large intestine can be differentiated from the small intestine by the presence of teniae, haustra, and omental appendices, in addition to a larger internal diameter.
Primeiro segmento do intestino grosso, o: First segment of the large intestine, where the ileum opens. The large intestine is formed by: cecum, ascending, transverse, descending, and sigmoid colons, rectum, and anal canal.
É um divertículo cecal cego e verdadeiro: It is a blind, true cecal diverticulum, measuring between 6 cm and 10 cm in length.
Projeção mucosa na junção ileocecal que: Mucosal projection at the ileocecal junction that prevents the backflow of fecal matter.
Abertura da porção terminal do íleo no c: Opening of the terminal portion of the ileum into the cecum.
Prega peritoneal que se estende entre o: Peritoneal fold that extends between the liver and the anterior abdominal wall, dividing the right and left lobes on the diaphragmatic surface.
Fibrous remnant of the umbilical vein. It forms the free margin of the falciform ligament.
Visível somente na face visceral, é loca: Visible only on the visceral surface, it is located more posteriorly and superiorly, between the fissure for the ligamentum venosum and the inferior vena cava.
Visible only on the visceral surface, it is located more anteriorly and inferiorly, between the round ligament of the liver and the gallbladder.
É um órgão saculiforme que armazena a bi: It is a sac-like organ that stores the bile produced by the liver.
Tem origem da artéria hepática comum e b: It originates from the common hepatic artery and bifurcates into right and left branches (arteries).
Responsável pela drenagem do sangue pouc: Responsible for draining deoxygenated, nutrient-rich blood from the intestine, gallbladder, pancreas, and spleen, directing it to the liver.
Formado pela união dos ductos hepáticos: Formed by the union of the right and left hepatic ducts, which drain bile from the respective hepatic lobes.
É formado pela junção do ducto hepático: It is formed by the junction of the common hepatic duct and the cystic duct. It follows a descending path and carries bile to the duodenum.
Tem origem no colo da vesícula biliar e: It originates from the neck of the gallbladder and joins the common hepatic duct to form the bile duct.
É um órgão em forma de saco, localizada: It is a sac-shaped organ, located inferiorly to the right lobe of the liver, whose function is to store bile, an exocrine secretion of the liver that aids in fat digestion in the intestine.
Sinônimo de hilo hepático, aloja as estr: Synonym for hepatic hilum, it houses the structures that enter or leave the liver, including the hepatic artery, portal vein, hepatic ducts, lymphatic vessels, and nerves.
Parte mais estreita da vesícula biliar q: Narrowest part of the gallbladder that keeps the cystic duct open, allowing the passage of bile.
Parte principal da vesícula biliar. Faz: Main part of the gallbladder. It contacts the visceral surface of the liver, transverse colon, and superior part of the duodenum.
Extremidade larga e arredondada da vesíc: Wide, rounded end of the gallbladder, visible at the inferior border of the liver.
Situa-se à esquerda dos vasos mesentéric: It lies to the left of the superior mesenteric vessels and is continuous with the tail of the organ. It is located anterior to the abdominal aorta and the L2 vertebra.
Tem estreita relação com o hilo esplênic: It is closely related to the splenic hilum and the left colic flexure, situated anterior to the left kidney.
Parte expandida do pâncreas, circundada: Expanded part of the pancreas, surrounded by the duodenal curvature, to the right of the superior mesenteric vessels, just below the pylorus. The bile duct is lodged in its parenchyma.
A cavidade oral consiste em vestíbulo da: A cavidade oral consiste em vestíbulo da boca e cavidade própria da boca. O vestíbulo é uma fenda entre os lábios e as bochechas, externamente, e a gengiva e os dentes, internamente. A cavidade própria da boca, por sua vez, é o espaço interno às arcadas dentais e contém a língua.
